groups.text: You give Chusky a goal. It can begin the research, gather the evidence, and bring the work back to you in a form you can review.

words.text: You give Chusky a goal. It can begin the research, gather the evidence, and bring the work back to you in a form you can review.

groups.text: It starts by looking for people who fit the brief, then checks the reasons behind each match. The list is built from the research, not guesswork.

words.text: It starts by looking for people who fit the brief, then checks the reasons behind each match. The list is built from the research, not guesswork.

groups.text: Each entry gets the useful context: what the company does, why it may fit, and what still needs your judgment. The sources stay close to the work.

words.text: Each entry gets the useful context: what the company does, why it may fit, and what still needs your judgment. The sources stay close to the work.

groups.text: From there, Chusky prepares a first message for each person, using the details it found. The drafts are saved in the workspace your team already uses.

words.text: From there, Chusky prepares a first message for each person, using the details it found. The drafts are saved in the workspace your team already uses.

groups.text: And then it pauses. The messages are ready, but this mission is waiting for your approval before anything is sent.

words.text: And then it pauses. The messages are ready, but this mission is waiting for your approval before anything is sent.

groups.text: You can review each draft, make changes, approve the next step, or hold the work. Chusky keeps that decision attached to the mission.

words.text: You can review each draft, make changes, approve the next step, or hold the work. Chusky keeps that decision attached to the mission.

groups.text: Once approved, the follow-up can be scheduled. The record shows what was prepared, what you authorized, when the next step is due, and the evidence behind it.

groups.text: Your team stays in control while the work keeps moving. Chusky. Give it the goal. Keep your authority.
